shots.action: Deep inside a dark tunnel, a car sits almost swallowed by the blackness, its headlights throwing two pale cones onto the curved concrete ahead. The car eases forward, gathering pace as it rolls out of the darkness and sweeps across the frame from left to right, its body catching the tunnel light as it passes. The surrounding walls, lane markings and hanging lamps slide past in the headlight wash, and the car clears the shadowed foreground to leave the tunnel behind.
